timing_verdict.label: GOOD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,340–1,350 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has strengthened significantly, with the KRW/USD rate falling to the 1,340s (a sharp 22.8 won drop in recent days and the largest decline in 2.5 months). A lower KRW/USD means the won is strong, so you need fewer won to buy your $2,000—making this a relatively favorable entry point for your monthly conversion.

TIP: Lock in this rate now if possible, as the news suggests volatility ahead; the won may weaken again if dollar strength resumes due to anticipated interest-rate hikes.
